description: Source file implementing the WriterFuzzerBase class for media writing fuzz testing, including buffer parsing, track info extraction, and data processing functions.

classes.name: WriterFuzzerBase::BufferSource
classes.description: Class for parsing and managing input buffer data for media tracks, including frame extraction and track info retrieval.

methods.name: getNumTracks
methods.description: Returns the number of tracks parsed from the input data.

methods.name: searchForMarker
methods.description: Searches backwards in the data for a frame marker starting from a given index.

methods.name: getConfigFormat
methods.description: Retrieves configuration format for a specific track.

methods.name: getNumCsds
methods.description: Returns the number of codec-specific data segments for a track.

methods.name: getFrameList
methods.description: Returns the list of frames for a specific track.

methods.name: getFrameInfo
methods.description: Analyzes the buffer data to extract frame information and populate frame lists.

methods.name: getTrackInfo
methods.description: Retrieves track-specific information such as mime type and parameters.
